description: Assumption: fully loaded cost of one retention call (agent time + admin). Everyone on the list is called, whether or not they would have left.
Assumption: annual profit the bank earns on a retained deposit balance (net interest margin). Part 1 of a retained customer's value.
Assumption: share of called customers who WOULD have left but stay because of the call. Customers who were never going to leave cannot be "saved".

unit: USD per retained customer per year
description: Assumption: annual profit from fees and other products, regardless of balance. Part 2 of a retained customer's value.
